name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.6 degrees south of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 15 times in 4 visits over 33 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 32 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 33 hours starting 2025-07-22, at wavelengths from 0.92 to 4.24 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
